nestedSelector.saveHelp: When enabled, the details page displays a snapshot of the submitted data. When disabled, data is queried live and is not submitted. Direct selection is used when saving is disabled or all matching records are saved. Search only affects browsing, not which records are saved in full. Filters under Interaction / Filter can reference fields in the current row and outside the table.
nestedSelector.uniqueHelp: Attributes marked as unique are listed below. Select attributes to validate uniqueness using their combined values. If none are selected, uniqueness is validated separately for each listed attribute.
nestedSelector.displayFieldRequired: Select at least one matrix attribute to display
nestedSelector.fieldKeyRequired: Enter the English name of each matrix attribute
nestedSelector.nestedContainerUnsupported: Table containers cannot be nested inside a table selector
nestedSelector.normalModeRequired: Use normal mode when saving is disabled or all matching records are saved
nestedSelector.filterInvalid: Complete the filters using regular fields in the current row or outside the table
nestedSelector.excelUnsupported: Table selector columns do not support Excel import or export. Only other columns are included.

help.activeautocollect: Activate the automatic collection relationship to be configured in the collection mapping management
help.upsideunique: Unique means that the upstream end can only be referenced once by the downstream end
help.downsideunique: Unique means that the downstream end can only be referenced once by the upstream end
help.deleteupside: When deleting upstream configuration items, automatically delete downstream configuration items
help.deletedownside: When deleting downstream configuration items, automatically delete upstream configuration items
help.cascaderrelation: When the current relationship data changes, the system will automatically calculate and update the cascade relationship data. The calculated cascade relationship will not trigger the cascade relationship calculation again, nor will it generate transaction data, so it cannot be modified in the record backtracking.
help.legalrule: Model rules: configuration items that do not satisfy the relevant constraints of model attributes and relationships are considered non-compliant; custom rules: configuration items that do not satisfy custom rules are considered non-compliant.
